snippet.title: 🌱 Farming Simulator: Signature Edition | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Farming Simulator: Signature Edition is out now!  From managing fields and forests to raising livestock and building a thriving agricultural empire, Farming Simulator: Signature Edition offers endless possibilities to grow - relaxing, and family-friendly! 

🌱 Built on Farming Simulator 25, the latest entry in the series 🌱
🌱 400+ authentic machines from top global brands 🌱
🌱 25 diverse crops, 3 distinct maps, and plenty of activities 🌱
🌱 Including Mercedes-Benz Trucks, the latest brand cooperation 🌱

🚜Get Farming Simulator: Signature Edition now!
► https://www.farming-simulator.com/buy-now.php

👨‍🌾 Learn how to play with the Farming Simulator Academy!
► https://farming-simulator.com/academy
